data.name: Odyssey - Echoes of Ithaca
data.detailed_description:
COOPERATIVE ACTION COMBAT

Fight against creatures of darkness in epic top-down action combat that has you shooting, slashing. and dashing your way through rooms packed with dangerous enemies. Work together to survive - cooperation may be your only chance to face the fearsome ogre Polyphemus and escape alive. Brave the darkness alone if you dare, but know that survival is far more unforgiving without an ally at your side.

FIGHT AS A LEGENDARY HERO

Take up arms as either the cunning Odysseus or his reliable second-in-command, Eurylochus, as you battle through relentless hordes of enemies. As Odysseus, wield the legendary Bow of Ithaca, pelting foes from afar while using evasive maneuvers to keep your distance. As Eurylochus, pick up sword and shield, hold the front line, protect your ally, and cut down enemies up close.

SLAY DARK MONSTERS

Face a wide variety of enemies - from twisted beings of the dark underworld to sheep that appear cute and cuddly… at first. Each enemy features unique abilities and vulnerabilities that will be up to you and your ally to discover and exploit.

CRAFT EPIC BUILDS

As you progress through the depths of the cave, enhance your abilities with powerful upgrades across six distinct categories: Valor, Vigilance, Finesse, Luck, Wit, and Fate - each offering unique mechanics that shape your playstyle and teamwork.

data.short_description: A fast-paced top-down roguelike inspired by The Odyssey. Fight creatures of darkness in intense co-op action combat as Odysseus or Eurylochus. Craft powerful builds, survive deadly encounters, and challenge the fearsome ogre Polyphemus.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8800 GT / AMD HD 6850 / Intel HD Graphics 4400 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
